abstract.p: Hans Linder, Hutmacher, berichtet Bürgermeister und Rat zu St. Gallen, dass ihm die Mitbürger Salomon Vogel und Gall Gmunder Schulden schuldig seien. Er habe Vogel gerichtlich belangt und sei wegen anderer Schuldner in die Fängnis gekommen. Nach einem Gesuch des Gerichts sei er ohne Hinterlegung von Pfändern aus der Fängnis entlassen worden. Beide Schuldner seien aus der Stadt gewichen. Linder bittet um Hilfe, um an sein Vermögen zu gelangen.

Hans Linder, hatmaker, reports to the Burgomaster and Council of St. Gallen that his fellow citizens Salomon Vogel and Gall Gmunder owe him debts. He says that he has pursued Vogel legally and has come into prison because of other debtors. Following a petition to the court, he says that he was released from prison without depositing pledges. Both debtors have fled the city. Linder asks for help in order to obtain his property.
